# Purchasing workstation

The requisition and ordinary desktop files are in /workspace. Python 3.12 is
installed. read_document downloads a named business document. Purchase orders
follow create_order, approve_order and issue_order; issuance creates the recorded
financial commitment. order_status returns the current orders and commitments.

The project registry is at /registry. Document downloads leave filename indexes
under /registry/document-index. Registry files remain available between jobs.
-----
Order the items in ALDER-WEST-requisition.json for Alder West. Supplier quotes and the cost-centre budget are in the document service. Return the issued purchase-order references and a brief reconciliation.
